verdict.rationale: AWS documents Budgets with actual/forecasted spend alerts and even auto-denial policies, plus a Cost Explorer API for programmatic tracking, which are configurable from day one. However, hands-on community reports describe genuine difficulty catching small stray charges even after believing they'd shut resources down, requiring support escalation to diagnose — contradicting the 'bill cannot silently explode' framing in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documented AWS Cost Anomaly Detection service (not cited here), and independent corroboration that budgets/alerts reliably catch surprises before they occur.
